subtopics.label: Viral Hepatitis Epidemiology, Treatment, and Elimination
subtopics.description: Research on hepatitis B, C, and D virus epidemiology, treatment access, elimination strategies, and outcomes across diverse populations including people who inject drugs, pregnant women, and underserved communities. Covers direct-acting antivirals, Medicaid policy, rapid treatment initiation, and global HCV/HBV prevalence studies.

subtopics.label: Cirrhosis, End-Stage Liver Disease, and Hepatic Complications
subtopics.description: Research on the clinical management, outcomes, and complications of cirrhosis and end-stage liver disease including hepatic encephalopathy, portal hypertension, ascites, kidney dysfunction, alcohol-associated liver disease, and mortality prediction. Covers pharmacologic treatments, hospitalization outcomes, and quality-of-care initiatives.

subtopics.label: Liver Transplantation: Access, Outcomes, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Research on liver transplantation including waitlist access, living donor practices, post-transplant outcomes, disparities by race and socioeconomic status, and management of specific conditions such as alcohol-associated liver disease, MASH, and hepatitis. Covers policy impacts such as Medicaid expansion on transplant access.

subtopics.label: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease, Metabolic Liver Disease, and Steatohepatitis
subtopics.description: Research on the pathogenesis, diagnosis, and management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD/MASLD) and metabolic steatohepatitis including fibrosis assessment, imaging biomarkers, genetic risk factors, comorbidities, and therapeutic interventions. Covers retinoic acid pathways, alcohol-associated liver disease mechanisms, and liver fibrosis noninvasive markers.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Clinical Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis covering medical therapies (biologics, small molecules), surgical techniques, endoscopic monitoring, pregnancy considerations, pediatric IBD, and disease-related complications including VTE and comorbidities. Includes comparative effectiveness of vedolizumab, ustekinumab, and TNF antagonists.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome, Mucosal Immunity, and Host-Microbiota Interactions
subtopics.description: Research on the gut microbiome's role in mucosal immunity, host metabolism, and disease including ILC biology, fungal microbiota, bile acid signaling, dietary fiber effects, and microbiota manipulation. Covers mechanisms by which commensal bacteria and fungi regulate immune tolerance, inflammation, and metabolic homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Cancer Biology, Genetics, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and neuroendocrine tumors covering molecular mechanisms (KRAS, RHAMM, NADK, epigenetic regulation), tumor microenvironment, surgical outcomes, and therapeutic strategies. Includes studies on PDAC precursor lesions, acinar cell carcinoma, and novel targeted therapies.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Cancer: Screening, Molecular Biology, and Surgical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on colorectal cancer encompassing screening disparities, molecular pathogenesis (WNT signaling, aPKC, SOX17), surgical management, endoscopic resection techniques, and outcomes. Covers Lynch syndrome, hereditary CRC, tumor immune microenvironment, and health equity in CRC screening and treatment.

subtopics.label: Endoscopic Procedures, Interventional GI, and Biliary Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy including EUS-guided procedures, ERCP, endoscopic resection techniques, anti-reflux endoscopic procedures, and biliary interventions. Covers procedural outcomes, novel devices, training, and management of biliary obstruction, pancreatic cysts, and GI bleeding.

subtopics.label: GERD, Esophageal Motility, and Anti-Reflux Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on gastroesophageal reflux disease, esophageal motility disorders, and anti-reflux surgical and endoscopic interventions including fundoplication, hiatal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. Covers physiologic assessment using impedance planimetry, pH monitoring, manometry, and outcomes of robotic and laparoscopic approaches.

subtopics.label: Obesity Management: Bariatric Surgery and Endoscopic Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and endoscopic treatments for obesity including endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty, intragastric balloons, Roux-en-Y gastric bypass revision, and bariatric surgery outcomes. Covers metabolic effects, GERD after bariatric procedures, diabetes remission, and comparison of virtual versus in-person follow-up care.

subtopics.label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Biliary Tract Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on hepatocellular carcinoma and biliary tract malignancies including intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, gallbladder neoplasms, and ampullary adenocarcinoma. Covers molecular pathogenesis, imaging-based diagnosis (LI-RADS), locoregional therapies, surgical outcomes, tumor microenvironment, and disparities in treatment and survival.

subtopics.label: Pancreatitis, Pancreatic Cysts, and Biliary Disease
subtopics.description: Research on acute and chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic cystic lesions, and biliary disease including diagnosis, management, and outcomes. Covers ERCP for biliary pancreatitis, morphologic severity assessment, pancreatic cyst cytology, MRI-based detection, and cholangioscopy for gallstone disease.

subtopics.label: Gastric and Esophageal Cancer: Molecular Targets and Clinical Trials
subtopics.description: Research on gastric, gastroesophageal junction, and esophageal adenocarcinoma covering molecular biomarkers (CLDN18.2, HER2, FGFR2, TP53), targeted therapies (zolbetuximab, andecaliximab), clinical trial outcomes, and genomic characterization. Includes studies on perioperative chemotherapy, surgical lymph node dissection, and real-world biomarker testing patterns.

subtopics.label: Celiac Disease, Eosinophilic Esophagitis, and Functional GI Disorders
subtopics.description: Research on celiac disease, eosinophilic esophagitis, microscopic colitis, and functional gastrointestinal disorders including IBS and constipation. Covers epidemiology, diagnostic approaches, dietary interventions, comorbidities, and management strategies including synbiotics, dietary enzyme supplementation, and pharmacologic treatments.

subtopics.label: Colorectal Surgery: Perioperative Outcomes, ERAS, and Disparities
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of colorectal conditions including colectomy outcomes, enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, minimally invasive techniques, and sociodemographic disparities in surgical care.

subtopics.label: Small Bowel Obstruction, Appendicitis, and Acute Abdominal Emergencies
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on the management, outcomes, and complications of acute abdominal emergencies including small bowel obstruction, acute appendicitis, and related surgical interventions.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and Gastrointestinal/Hepatic Manifestations
subtopics.description: Studies examining the gastrointestinal and hepatic effects of SARS-CoV-2 infection, including GI symptoms, organoid models of infection, liver involvement in children, and pandemic impacts on GI care delivery.

subtopics.label: Liver Disease and Hepatic Conditions in Pregnancy
subtopics.description: Research on liver-related conditions during and after pregnancy, including intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, drug-induced liver injury, elevated ALT, NAFLD, and hepatitis B management in pregnant women.

subtopics.label: Hepatocyte Culture Models, AAV Gene Therapy, and Liver Repopulation
subtopics.description: Experimental studies developing and utilizing primary human hepatocyte culture systems, AAV vector-based gene delivery, and in vivo liver repopulation models for liver disease research and therapy.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome in Transplant Recipients and Infectious Complications
subtopics.description: Studies examining gut microbiota composition, dysbiosis, and infectious complications in hematopoietic cell transplant and solid organ transplant recipients, including post-transplant diarrhea and pathogen colonization.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Stem Cells, Epithelial Biology, and Mucosal Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Research on intestinal stem cell biology, epithelial cell lineage specification, mucosal homeostasis, and the molecular pathways regulating intestinal epithelial identity and regeneration.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells, Dietary Fiber, and Intestinal Inflammation
subtopics.description: Studies on innate lymphoid cell (ILC) biology in the gut, including ILC2 and ILC3 roles in intestinal inflammation, dietary fiber effects on ILC responses, and mucosal immune regulation.

subtopics.label: Schistosomiasis and Parasitic Infections Affecting the GI Tract
subtopics.description: Research on the gastrointestinal and immunological effects of schistosome and other parasitic infections, including mucosal pathology, immune modulation, microbiome disruption, and interactions with viral infections.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome in Metabolic Disease, Stroke, and Neurological Conditions
subtopics.description: Studies linking gut microbiota composition and function to metabolic disorders, ischemic stroke risk, and neurological outcomes, including microbiome-deficient mouse models and gut-brain axis interactions.

subtopics.label: Neonatal and Pediatric Gastrointestinal Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on gastrointestinal conditions in neonates and children, including necrotizing enterocolitis, neonatal intestinal obstruction, Hirschsprung disease, pediatric aspiration, and recurrent croup.

subtopics.label: Advanced Endoscopic Resection Techniques and Novel Endoscopic Devices
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical studies evaluating novel endoscopic platforms, traction devices, and techniques for endoscopic submucosal dissection and full-thickness resection of GI lesions.

subtopics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy, Tumor Microenvironment, and Novel Therapeutic Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on immunotherapy approaches for GI and other cancers, including immune checkpoint blockade, tumor microenvironment modulation, antibody-drug conjugates, and engineered therapeutic agents.

subtopics.label: Hepatic Lipid Metabolism, Steatosis, and Metabolic Dysfunction
subtopics.description: Studies on hepatic lipid metabolism pathways, including de novo lipogenesis, fatty acid trafficking, adipocyte browning, and metabolic dysfunction in obesity and liver disease models.

subtopics.label: Fecal Microbiota Transplantation, Synbiotics, and Microbiome-Targeted Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on therapeutic manipulation of the gut microbiome through fecal microbiota transplantation, synbiotics, and microbiome-guided interventions for IBD, IBS, and related conditions.
